## About
Oily's Automotive is a family shop on W. Orangethorpe Ave in Fullerton. After many years in the new car industry, Babington Rice opened his own place so he could focus on customer service in a way the dealer environment did not allow.
His son Dylan runs the front office as manager. You'll catch him there ready to help get you back on the road. We focus on the best experience and the best overall value, not the lowest price, and we pledge to treat you with the honesty and respect we all deserve.
We provide Fullerton and the surrounding area with quality automotive repairs.

## Services
- Oil Change: An oil change and oil filter replacement, one of the preventative maintenance services we offer.
- Brake Service: Quick brake repair and replacement for domestic and import vehicles.
- Radiator Service: Radiator repair and coolant flush to keep things cool under the hood.
- Transmission Service: Transmission fluid is a vital part of keeping your car going for the long haul.
- Starters: Starters are pretty durable, but most will eventually fail. If the crank is operating slowly, bring it in.
- Alternators: When your alternator begins to malfunction, bring it in for alternator replacement as soon as you can.
- Power Steering Service: Clears contaminants from the system, including rack and pinion, pump and lines.
- Fuel Induction Service: Clears out the carbon deposits that build up inside your engine.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: No appointment is necessary. You're welcome to call ahead too.

Q: Do you charge to figure out what's wrong?
A: Diagnosis and brake checks are free.

Q: Will you pressure me into extra repairs?
A: No. One reviewer, Kenzie, said we're never pushy and only do the work you ask for.
